newsitem.title: USA: Clinton wants to knock down foreign trade barriers.
newsitem.headline: Clinton wants to knock down foreign trade barriers.

text.p: The United States must knock down more foreign trade barriers to American goods over the next four years, President Clinton said on Thursday.
"American exports are at record levels," he said in a speech accepting the Democratic Party's nomination for the presidency.

"In the next four years, we must break down even more barriers, reaching out to Latin America, Africa and Asia, making sure America's workers and America's products -- the world's best -- get the free and fair trade they deserve," he added.
